problemStatement.formal: For conjugate exponents p, q > 1 with 1/p + 1/q = 1, equality holds in Hölder's inequality iff the sequences (or functions) satisfy power proportionality: f^p = c · g^q.
problemStatement.plain: Formalize when equality holds in Hölder's inequality, for finite sums, inner product spaces, and integrals.
whyMatters: Characterizes extremizers of fundamental inequalities in analysis
Prerequisite for duality theory in Lp spaces
Unifies Cauchy-Schwarz and Hölder equality cases under a single framework

approaches.name: Young deficit framework
approaches.description: Express Hölder deficit as sum/integral of pointwise Young deficits. Use sum/integral of nonneg = 0 to force each deficit = 0. Apply Young's equality case for power proportionality.
